summary: Every node now authenticates with its own revocable scoped device token instead of a shared admin key. Roles: nrf_pendant, mac_bridge, mobile. Route->scope table lives in cloud-relay/relayScopes.js and is unit-tested (relayScopes.test.js, devicePairing.test.js).
revocation: POST /v1/ops/credentials/:tokenId/revoke (admin-scoped). Revoked tokens 401 on HTTP and on both socket handshakes; verified live.
defaultDeny: requiredScopesForRoute returns null for unlisted paths and the middleware denies null for EVERYONE including admin. Any new route must be added to the table or it 403s universally.
knownDeadRoute: visionLoopRelay.js plans /v1/vision/classify-ui-state, which is unlisted and therefore currently denied to all principals.
verified: 59 live checks against the deployed relay with throwaway tokens, since revoked.
